instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium full shot. On a sunny rooftop patio, a group of friends dances joyfully. In the center foreground, the woman with short blonde hair (R9) in a denim jacket, black crop top, and black skirt dances with her right arm raised. To her left, the woman in a black beanie and khaki capris (R8) moves with arms outstretched, while behind her, the woman in a neon green dress (R7) raises both arms. On the right, the man with curly hair in a brown jacket (R10) dances with a smile. Bright afternoon sunlight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the concrete floor.
elements: R9 is the center-foreground dancer with her right arm raised
R7 raises both arms behind R8
the group dances on a sunny rooftop patio
